en.text: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神啊，求你救我脱离仇敌，

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝啊，求你救我脫離仇敵，

en.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

zhSimplified.text: 求你救我脱离作孽的人

zhTraditional.text: 求你救我脫離作孽的人

en.text: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，他们埋伏要害我的命；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，他們埋伏要害我的命；

en.text: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. up, behold, and help me!

zhSimplified.text: 我虽然无过，他们预备整齐，跑来攻击我。

zhTraditional.text: 我雖然無過，他們預備整齊，跑來攻擊我。

en.text: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors.

zhSimplified.text: 万军之 神—耶和华的 神啊！

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之上帝－耶和華的上帝啊！

en.text: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
Behold, they spew with their mouth. are in their lips, For”, they say, “who hears us?”

zhSimplified.text: 他们口中喷吐，嘴里有刀； ：有谁听见？

zhTraditional.text: 他們口中噴吐，嘴裏有刀； ：有誰聽見？

en.text: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 但你—耶和华必笑话他们；

zhTraditional.text: 但你－耶和華必笑話他們；

en.text: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

zhSimplified.text: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你，

zhTraditional.text: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你，

en.text: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神要以慈爱迎接我； 。

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝要以慈愛迎接我； 。

en.text: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

zhSimplified.text: 不要杀他们，恐怕我的民忘记。

zhTraditional.text: 不要殺他們，恐怕我的民忘記。

en.text: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

zhSimplified.text: 因他们口中的罪和嘴里的言语，

zhTraditional.text: 因他們口中的罪和嘴裏的言語，

en.text: Consume them in wrath. them, and they will be no more. them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 求你发怒，使他们消灭， 中间掌权，

zhTraditional.text: 求你發怒，使他們消滅， 中間掌權，

en.text: At evening let them return. them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

zhSimplified.text: 到了晚上，任凭他们转回；

zhTraditional.text: 到了晚上，任憑他們轉回；

en.text: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

zhSimplified.text: 他们必走来走去，寻找食物，

zhTraditional.text: 他們必走來走去，尋找食物，

en.text: But I will sing of your strength. I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

zhSimplified.text: 我的力量啊，我要歌颂你；

zhTraditional.text: 我的力量啊，我要歌頌你；
